name: Bitmax Co., Ltd
summary: Headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, Bitmax Co., Ltd, established in 2010, specializes in creating and advancing sophisticated augmented reality (AR) software. A core offering is the MAXST AR SDK, a versatile, cross-platform engine that empowers developers to build a wide array of AR applications. Furthermore, the company provides the MAXST Sensor Fusion SLAM solution, specifically engineered for integration into mobile devices, wearables, and robotic systems. Their portfolio also features MAXWORK 1.5, an industrial AR service meticulously optimized for advanced environments such as 5G, IoT, and smart factories. Previously known as MAXST Co., Ltd., the company is scheduled to officially adopt the name Bitmax Co., Ltd in February 2025.
